Habitat.reasoning: Describes the specific habitat/land-use used as a sampling location.

Groundcover (%).reasoning: Measures the percentage of ground cover present in the sample area.

Surface temperature (°C).reasoning: Records the surface temperature measurement taken at the sampling site.

Vapor pressure deficit (kPa).reasoning: Measures the vapor pressure deficit in kilopascals for the sample location.

Soil moisture (%).reasoning: Quantifies the soil moisture content as a percentage of the sample area.

Soil pH.reasoning: Measures the acidity or alkalinity of the soil at the sampling site.

Plant diversity.reasoning: Quantifies the variety of plant species present in the sample area.

Time since fire (years).reasoning: Records how many years have passed since a fire event occurred at the site.
